references.text: The Lord will judge his people and have compassion on his servants - the same theme of God's judgment and mercy toward his people
God judges his people - division of the theme concerning God's judgment over Israel
Direct quote in the New Testament: 'The Lord will judge his people' - the apostle uses this verse to warn against falling away
A prayer that the Lord would have compassion on his servants - the same concept of God's mercy toward his servants
Describes a situation where no one was left, neither free nor bound - similar expression about 'no one left, neither bound nor free'
The conclusion of Moses' song where the Lord avenges the blood of his servants - the same context of God's care for his people
The Lord takes comfort by taking vengeance on his enemies - a similar theme of God acting on behalf of his people
